narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a social commentary on traditional gender roles and domestic labor distribution in modern families. The creator uses the context of dining out with children to argue for more proactive male participation in parenting, criticizing the 'pseudo-single parent' phenomenon. The intent is to empower viewers with logical arguments against the excuse that 'earning money' excuses a lack of help at home.
